newsitem.title: UK: "Friends" star Aniston in Fabrege Lynx ad.
newsitem.headline: "Friends" star Aniston in Fabrege Lynx ad.

text.p: Jennifer Aniston, star of the U.S. television series "Friends", will make her debut in a British television commercial, appearing in an ad for Elida Fabrege's male body spray Lynx, the company's advertising agency said on Friday.
Bartle Bogle Hegarty said the ad continues the "Lynx effect" theme it earlier developed, this time featuring a young man getting ready for a date with his dream girl.
Aniston, however, plays not the dream girl, but the young man's doting girlfriend, waiting patiently at home for him.

As the man gets ready for his date, liberally spraying on Lynx in front of the bathroom mirror, he fantasises about meeting a gorgeous girl at a white mansion. She laughs at his jokes, is impressed by his Volkswagen Beetle car and admires his clothes. The couple stroll in the moonlight, sit by a fountain and are about to kiss when the sky explodes in fireworks.

Suddenly a woman is calling the man's name, and he snaps back to reality. The woman calling him is Aniston, who seductively asks: "Do you have to go out tonight?" The man looks at the camera, and the audience knows he will go out.
